articles.description: Cincinnati Reds star shortstop Elly De La Cruz earned his career Silver Slugger award following a breakout year, just ahead of first-time arbitration.
articles.title: Reds SS Elly De La Cruz boosts value with first Silver Slugger award

articles.description: Reds infielder Elly De La Cruz attended the MLB Awards with his brother, Pedro, and co-host Roy Wood Jr. joked about the twins' height difference.
articles.title: MLB show host jokes about Elly De La Cruz stealing food from his twin

articles.description: Closer Emilio Pagán figured to be one of the few returning bright spots for the Cincinnati Reds before quickly striking a free agent deal in Detroit.
articles.title: Reds offseason plans take hit with Emilio Pagán signing with Detroit

articles.description: Carter Graham, 25, was named the Cincinnati Reds minor-league player of the year after hitting .300 with 29 home runs combined at High-A and Double-A.
articles.title: Reds name Carter Graham minors player of year, shield him from Rule 5
